paragraphs.text: The Firstorm Phoenix is a deity worshipped in Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria .

The Firestorm Phoenix's real name (if any) is unknown, but it is represented as a great bird of prey flaring with fire. It is a god of heat and fire, and its aid was beseeched by Hazezon Tamar in a ritual of Visions where he asked it for warm updrafts on the wind.
